opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; must not resubmit an unsuccessful application unless invited; must be submitted within specified deadlines; must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based public engagement and outreach activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines and three application rounds; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold RSC membership as Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) before submitting; hold an independent research post; not currently hold another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs/access. Round 1 closed; Round 2 opens 12 October 2026 and closes 30 November 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to PhD students or researchers at any career stage, in any sector or location. Applicants must hold RSC membership as Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) before submitting and for the duration of the grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers to establish and develop national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations and networks, including research visits to collaborators and organising meetings/workshops. Round 2 open from 3 August 2026, closing 21 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or (if based outside) holding valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event; must have an active role in the event (except structured training/CPD).
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering additional costs of care they usually provide (up to £1,200 per year). Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or (if based outside) holding valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must use funds to cover costs of support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend/participate in a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event (except structured training/CPD).
opportunities.summary: Supports individuals with disabilities and ongoing health conditions to reduce accessibility challenges when attending chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events, covering equipment, services or other personal expenses associated with access needs (up to £1,200 per year). Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.
